item.title: Hutchison takes legal action over Panama port concession ruling
item.description: Panama Ports Company (PPC) majority owner CK Hutchison announced today it was taking legal action over Panama’s decision to rescind its operating concession covering the ports of Balboa and Cristobal. Last week, Panama’s Supreme Court of Justice ruled the 2021 extension to PPC’s operating concession “unconstitutional”.
